maneuver.name: Sprint
maneuver.effect: Increase Movement Speeds by 50% for the rest of the turn
maneuver.runtime_tracking: transient effect is logged; no persistent Movement Capability mutation is invented

ability.name: Sprint
ability.trigger: user uses the Sprint Action during Combat
ability.triggered_effect: controlled user gains +2 Speed Combat Stages
ability.passive_effect: Overland Speed is always increased by +2
ability.passive_runtime: source information only in this layer; no new capability mutation is invented

composite_policy.activate_ability_with_maneuver: requires Standard Action for Sprint plus an independently available Swift Action and the Sprint Ability Scene use
composite_policy.standard_to_swift_conversion: not allowed for the composite activation because the Standard Action is already reserved/spent by the Sprint Maneuver
composite_policy.maneuver_only: remains available whenever Standard Action is available, including after Sprint Ability is exhausted
composite_policy.transactions: Maneuver and Ability use distinct namespaced resource transactions linked by a compositeId
composite_policy.refund: resource-only Undo may correct each transaction independently; it does not rewind the +2 Speed CS effect
